modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Preparing for pre-treatment and surface preparation process

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done by interpreting the drawing/work instructions/SOPs
identify and select the material, tools, equipment, jigs and accessories as per the job requirements
check the tools, equipment, jigs and material for any defects, expiry date etc. before use
check the jig to identify the loading points and locking points in it are as per job requirements
lift the vehicle body parts manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as per the work instructions
check that vehicle body or parts are cleaned and they are free from oil/dirt/different foreign material

modules.module_title: Inspect bath system for pre-treatment and surface preparation process

pcs.pc_description: carry out general check of feed valve, drain valve, filter condition, pressure difference and other quality control item of bath system as mentioned in SOP

check that magnetic separator, oil separator, phosphate sludge (for phosphate dip process), heating system (heat exchanger) of Phosphate solution and spray nozzles (blocking of hole) are in working condition
check the water quality to ensure that it is free from chlorine and other impurities, PH and conductivity is maintained as per norms
check the bath temperature and record it as per SOP/work instruction
use gauges to identify the required pressure difference across filter (cartridge/stainer) and then clean/ replace the filter (cartridge/stainer) if required

modules.module_title: Conduct pre-treatment and surface preparation process

pcs.pc_description: perform all pre-treatment and surface preparation processes on vehicle body/parts as per the requirements/specification
maintain bath pointage as per SOP/work instruction
check required temperature of baking oven before starting ED process and ensure that baking is done within the stipulated time
check part for phosphate coating condition after phosphate process and ED coating condition after ED process to confirm that coating quality is as per SOP
apply pressurized air on the vehicle body/ parts for removal of any unwanted extra ED drops is as per SOP
check ED coating parameters (Dry Film Thickness (DFT), Gloss, Methyl Isobutyl Ketone (MIBK) rub test, etc) and record data as per SOP
check the part condition after final rinse to ensure that it is free from water break, dust and other defects as per SOP
support the operator in unloading the vehicle body/parts and jigs after completion of all processess on skids for the painting activities
dispose waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations

modules.module_title: Preparing for sealer and paint work

pcs.pc_description: identify and select the sealing and painting material, tools, equipment, jigs and accessories as per the SOP and job requirements
check the tools, equipment, jigs and material for any defects, expiry date etc. before use
check that vehicle body or parts are cleaned and they are free from oil/dirt/different foreign material
read the body drawing to identify the sealing and painting area including water leakage point
check sealer gun pressure before starting sealer application
use masking tape to mask the area where sealing and painting application is not required
apply under body sealer (PVC) on floor area with drain caps and with required thickness as per SOP/work instruction
check that no pin holes are formed in sealer to avoid shower leakage
check and ensure no extra under body sealer (PVC) on part as mentioned in SOP/work instruction
apply stone guard coating (SGC) as per SOP/work instruction
check and ensure no extra stone guard coating (SGC) as per SOP/work instruction
check and record wet film thickness (WFT) of under body sealing (PVC)
check and repair defects like sealer pin hole, sealer crack, no sealer, ED drop, dry film thickness of SGC.
identify base color and select appropriate colorants suitable for color match as per the requirements/instructions
mix specified amount of paint material with additives as per specified ratio by following standard procedure
check the paint viscosity and add reducer/thinner/water to adjust viscosity of paint mix as per requirement

modules.module_title: Apply coatings of paint on the vehicle body

pcs.pc_description: ensure that spray paint gun air pressure and flow is adjusted and maintained as per the job requirement
apply primer on vehicle body parts as per the requirements/specification
apply appropriate coats of paint on vehicle body parts as per the requirements/specification
maintain booth parameters (temperature, relative humidity (RH), etc) during the painting process as per SOP
check that paint coverage is uniform and there are no patches on the painted parts
check the painted parts for defects, required quality and characteristics such as thickness, flakiness, peeling, shade match as per shade card
write the defect on inspection check sheet as per SOP
repair the defects on painted parts as per SOP
check the parts again for defects and put the final confirmation through stamp if defect is repaired as per SOP
ensure that painting operator is tagging and storing the right quality parts properly and maintaining a record of the same by following organisational policies and procedures
ensure that the work area is unmasked and cleaned properly after completion of work
dispose waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
